youtube_title: Phone Stolen? Block It All Over India (Sanchar Saathi). Rules You Didn't Know #21 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #21. Your phone got stolen. A: nothing can be done. B: you can block it all over India on a government portal. Comment!
Answer: B. First file a police complaint (many states let you do it online). Then on the Sanchar Saathi portal (sancharsaathi.gov.in), use 'Block your lost/stolen mobile' with the IMEI number and the complaint copy. The phone gets blocked on every Indian network, so it won't work with any SIM. Got it back? Unblock it on the same portal.
Tip: dial *#06# now and note your IMEI.
Source: DoT Sanchar Saathi (CEIR) portal.
